phases.title: Agency and civilization
phases.entry_rule: D0 plus approved local model/interface contracts; fixtures may support isolated development

work_packages.description: Implement agent identity, lineage-based birth/death, budgeted policy actions, and articulated-body contacts through the Phase 6 S13 interface.
Implement value learning and bounded planning with explicit training inputs, costs, policy state, and deterministic random-stream identities.
Implement physically carried skill transmission and persistent traces; record variant frequencies, source histories, fidelity and transmission delays.
Connect combustion, heat transfer and food transformations to agent tending actions and energy-budget observations; keep discovery detectors separate from physics.
Connect fracture geometry, composite assembly, wear and reduction chemistry to tool-use and experimentation scenarios.
Connect agent preferences to selection events, persistent structures, waste fluxes, role specialization and direct exchange.
Build controlled scenario harnesses, population/individual comparisons and the versioned agent/culture interface; record D9 compression assumptions.

dependencies: Phase 8 validated bodies, lineage, resource budgets and sensory transduction
Phase 4 chemical transformations; Phase 5 material properties; Phase 6 contact/fracture and S13 articulated dynamics
Phase 7 environmental forcing and declared scenario geography
Global tick, stable entity/event identities, versioned stochastic streams, and a declared population-compression comparison protocol
acceptance: Foraging and depleted-resource controls close declared budgets and produce logged births/deaths without injected resources.
Held-out obstacle tasks test learning; policy compute, memory and body actions have explicit costs.
A variant cannot reach an isolated recipient without a recorded sensory or material transmission path; propagation respects channel latency.
Tool geometry and processing effects are checked against lower-layer reference cases before measuring adoption.
Compare detailed villages with reduced populations using predeclared observables, uncertainty and shock windows; preserve exact identity/lineage fields where the contract promises exactness.
Report discovery, non-discovery and alternative ordering across a declared ensemble; permit a separate declared fixture to test industrial affordances.
limits: The claimed 10,000 years equals 100,000 generations is not generally valid; derive generations from each modeled lineage's life history.
Cooking-to-brain allocation, domestication and profession patterns are hypotheses, not mandatory historical outcomes to tune into existence.
S14 fixes wording only. A one-clock scheduling test must accompany the future agent implementation.

phases.title: Technology and knowledge
phases.entry_rule: D0 plus approved local model/interface contracts; fixtures may support isolated development

work_packages.description: Implement controlled agent interventions, calibration records, immutable experiment inputs and a claims/replication ledger.
Assemble bounded heat-engine and transport reference scenarios from validated material, contact and continuum mechanisms.
Consume S15 time-dependent electrical regimes; implement grid/load/fault records and physical oscillator timing.
Implement communication, echo and astronomical measurement fixtures using declared EM, geometry, thrust and cosmological boundaries.
Implement auditable computation artifacts and nested-engine orchestration under S16, with parent/child identities, budgets, provenance and depth limits.
Connect bounded biological intervention and template-editing experiments to validated chemical and population interfaces.
Implement physical-link packet transport and claim diffusion comparisons; freeze the claims/artifact interfaces and record D10.

dependencies: Phase 9 agent and culture interfaces; Phase 5 constitutive/material cases; Phase 6 mechanics and extended EM
Phase 7 source/sky/gravity models and declared expansion domain
Phase 8 biological models for W6
Versioned experiment capture or explicitly costed whole-prefix replay; no mutable live-state pointers in claims
S18 ownership relation must land in the upstream artifact interface before consumers require it
acceptance: Replay a recorded intervention from immutable inputs; separately assess independent experimental replication with an appropriate stochastic comparison.
Reference machine cases close energy and loss accounting and satisfy the domain's thermodynamic bounds before agents are asked to discover them.
Capacitor/inductor/transmission/propagation reference cases pass upstream; device classifiers consume results without defining hidden physical recipes.
Nested seed derivation is namespaced, logged and stable; altered child identity is detected; prohibited depth is refused and logged; parent and child budgets reconcile.
Network on/off comparisons preserve physical latency and matched resource budgets.
Test-side classifiers, fixture injections and endogenous discoveries are labeled distinctly in outputs.
limits: The full acceptance paragraph requires named technologies while the verification section permits skipped technologies; separate capability fixtures from stochastic discovery experiments.
A host-side child engine is a software orchestration prototype until an explicit equivalence contract relates it to in-world physical computation.
Instrument ground truth belongs in validation; agents must not receive inaccessible oracle values.
Direction-only doping evidence does not establish reliable switching devices; unsupported classes need an upstream model revision or a disclosed alternate fixture.

phases.title: People and society
phases.entry_rule: D0 plus approved local model/interface contracts; fixtures may support isolated development

work_packages.description: Implement explicit organ/exposure response records and operational policy-calibration statistics without real-person diagnostic labels.
Implement learned sanction predictions, enforcement costs and common-resource experiments through existing sensory/action channels.
Implement training investments, role histories and educational coalition records; measure cohort outcomes and adjustment lags.
Implement communication fidelity, intelligibility and declared graph-clustering measurements over geography and networks.
Implement claim-complex transmission, costly signaling and coalition turnover as explicit, testable mechanisms.
Implement artifact- and resource-constrained conflict/arbitration scenarios and record-integrity controls, with harm and cost accounting.
Implement reduced social-state interfaces, detailed-region comparisons, scenario harnesses and D11 validity records.

dependencies: Validated Phase 8 population/body interfaces and Phase 9 agency/culture
Phase 10 claims, artifacts and communication channels
S17 norms-as-environment boundary; no society-to-policy-weight write path
Layer-owned reduced-state contracts, exact membership identities and declared approximate graph observables
acceptance: Sanctions influence an agent only through recorded observations and the agent's own policy update path; unauthorized policy writes fail boundary tests.
Matched resource-sharing controls report outcome distributions and enforcement expenditure; reachability tests are distinct from claims about how often outcomes occur.
Membership survives member turnover with explicit birth/death events; classifiers never merge individual identity with group identity.
Communication barriers and cohort interventions have registered observables, controls and uncertainty; alternative behavioral models are evaluated.
Reduced institutions preserve specified invariants and remain within predeclared distributional error on normal and shock fixtures.
limits: Forced dual commons outcomes, fixed schooling advantages and prescribed conflict substitution are hypotheses to test, not universal software invariants.
A prediction-error or resilience statistic is not a validated reduction of human mental health, religion, ethnicity or culture.
Code vocabulary bans supplement architecture tests; they cannot establish that a social outcome was not implicitly authored.

phases.title: Money and politics
phases.entry_rule: D0 plus approved local model/interface contracts; fixtures may support isolated development

work_packages.description: Consume the upstream S18 ownership/transfer contract; implement obligation records, counterparties, terms and circulation measurements.
Implement resource-backed claim and maturity records and controlled confidence/liquidity experiments.
Implement convertibility and record-supply interventions plus resource-priced verification, forks and conflicting-claim handling.
Implement extraction, enforcement, collective counting and sovereign obligation scenarios using existing physical and social channels.
Implement declared control-topology, distribution, mobility and overlap measures across conditional environment panels.
Implement claim-diffusion and audit-capacity experiments that report mechanism statistics and retain negative outcomes.
Implement reduced record/prediction state, all accounting rigs, D12 limits and the public polity interface.

dependencies: Phase 11 enforcement, communication and agent-state contracts
Phase 10 artifact/claim records, S18 ownership events and S16 verification provenance
Validated physical resource/production interfaces and an explicit nominal-versus-physical accounting model
Identities, obligations and pending transfers must have complete save/replay semantics
acceptance: A bookkeeping transfer alone cannot create or destroy physical stock; ownership totals and counterparty references reconcile exactly under supported transfers.
Ownership survives compression/restoration to the declared exact representation; approximation of distribution summaries is separately budgeted.
Controlled default, confidence and liquidity cases report event ordering with matched physical conditions and uncertainty.
Conflicting verification rules and double-spend attempts have explicit, replayable outcomes; computational/energy cost is recorded.
Regime, inequality and information-diffusion comparisons expose initialization, policy rules and alternative models; rejected hypotheses remain reported evidence.
limits: The required tenfold nominal change with unchanged future physical flux is too strong: accounting must not directly create matter, but agents may change real production in response.
Consent-versus-racket superiority, fixed wealth-tail bands and false-claim spread order are conditional research hypotheses, not unconditional acceptance laws.
A deterministic replay log is not automatically a cryptographic or economic verification system.

phases.title: Infrastructure and externalities
phases.entry_rule: D0 plus approved local model/interface contracts; fixtures may support isolated development

work_packages.description: Implement owned structure records, terrain-related construction costs, degradation histories and maintenance obligations.
Implement bounded routing, freight/spoilage, water and waste flow scenarios with explicit capacity and environmental inputs.
Implement regional energy/material chain accounting, depletion records and recycling comparisons.
Consume S19 producer attribution and S20 local concentrations; integrate exposure and only supported response functions.
Implement controlled network failure and debris scenarios with explicit hazard, exposure and vulnerability components.
Implement traceable consequence/response records and interventions whose effects propagate through modeled physical delays.
Implement scenario harnesses, attribution/exposure compression comparisons, D13 limits and the infra interface.

dependencies: Phase 12 ownership/obligations and Phase 11 modeled response interfaces
Phase 5 materials; Phase 6 mechanics; Phase 7 terrain, reservoirs, hazards and tracer coupling
S19 and S20 must be implemented upstream before P13-W4; S2 and S13 before their dependent structures or moving machinery
A supported response function identifier, units and domain must accompany every modeled effect claim
acceptance: Physical and attributed balances reconcile through transport, mixing, deposition, recycling and aggregation; unknown attribution remains explicit.
Exposure-only substances without a validated response curve produce unknown effects, not invented harm or assumed harmlessness.
Reference transport and terrain cases establish numerical behavior before integrated scenarios; matched maintenance/hazard tests isolate causal factors.
A consequence record resolves its source, composition, transport and response evidence; enforcement remains a modeled agent/institution action.
Intervention response retains measured physical transport lags and stays inside declared resolution and compression error budgets.
limits: Require ensemble behavior and controls instead of two seeds being forced to choose opposite conventions or every intact network surviving a storm.
Passive tracer transport does not include reactive chemistry unless the coupling explicitly supplies it.
An attribution or citation chain is not proof of a real causal dose-response relation or legal responsibility.

phases.title: Perception memory and detail
phases.entry_rule: D0 plus approved local model/interface contracts; fixtures may support isolated development

work_packages.description: Implement gaze/instrument/archive observation maps and simulated frame allocation; preserve the existing probe as a regression fixture.
Implement knowledge records with source, resolution, time, confidence and prior/observation classification plus memory/record persistence.
Implement the resolution governor only after its observable parity and conservation comparison contract exists; include all governor cost.
Implement physical-channel testimony and provenance-preserving reconciliation without privileged information transfer.
Connect the observation-map provider to physical observation consumers under an explicit two-level semantics contract.
Build occlusion, memory, archive, communication, hidden-event and detailed/reduced comparison fixtures.
Record D14/D15 and freeze versioned observation, allocation and epistemic interfaces with the reviewed benchmark corpus.

dependencies: Phase 9 agent budgets; Phase 10 instruments and networks; Phase 11 intelligibility; Phase 13 attributed physical records
S21 provider contract plus actual gaze mechanics; S22 simulated-time allocation events
Layer-owned reduction semantics and S7/S24 certificate behavior
A decision distinguishing exact retained fields, approximate observables and inferred/reconstructed detail
acceptance: Identical scripted and gaze-derived observation maps produce identical consumer behavior within the declared same-build fixture; this does not establish general observer independence.
Inject host-clock and scheduling jitter without changing simulated allocation traces, events or supported replay outputs.
Unsupported detail in an asserted observation is rejected; priors and estimates remain labeled and keep their provenance.
Compare detailed/reduced physical and epistemic observables against predeclared tolerances, including hidden causal influences, rare events and shocks.
Measure cost improvement with identical workloads, named hardware and governor overhead; the source's 40% ambition is a benchmark target, not a present result.
limits: Lossy reduction cannot promise exact restoration of discarded beliefs or states; exactness applies only to retained fields or a validated reconstruction contract.
News cannot precede every physical arrival because its own signal is physical; compare explicitly named channels, such as communication arrival versus weather-front arrival.
Perceptual allocation does not validate the physical collapse model or establish that observation creates existence.

phases.title: Runtime and scalability
phases.entry_rule: D0 plus approved local model/interface contracts; fixtures may support isolated development

work_packages.description: Migrate validated model state to index-based data-oriented stores with complete serialization and explicit migration compatibility.
Implement a scheduler that consumes owning-layer interval certificates, refines on invalidation and refuses unsupported coarse states.
Introduce CPU/GPU or partitioned execution only after deterministic event ordering and typed causal/aggregate channel contracts are tested.
Implement build-aware replay and separately labeled exact and approximate comparisons over a declared environment/hardware matrix.
Measure integrated throughput, memory, logging, transfers and observable error on named workloads/hardware with repeatability intervals.
Run the versioned semantic conformance corpus against the optimized execution; investigate any contract failure before optimization acceptance.
Record D16, supported replay configurations, resource/error budgets and runtime interfaces.

dependencies: Implemented and validated owning-layer models; Phase 14 observation/reduction semantics for the full runtime
S23 build identities and equivalence labels; S24 certificates from materials, biology, technology, society and monetary records
S7/S9 versioning and S16 child-run compatibility
A complete snapshot inventory including allocator state, pending events, RNG addressing, pool order and scheduler/certificate state
acceptance: Round-trip complete supported snapshots and continue to the reference outputs; a memory copy or absence of pointers alone is insufficient evidence.
Same-build exact comparisons run only within the declared tested numerical compatibility class; cross-build comparisons use explicit observable/error policies.
Under queue, transfer and partition stress, no causal events are lost and all permitted aggregate delays are bounded and recorded.
Certificate boundary, invalidation and exhaustion fixtures trigger the declared refine/rollback/refuse behavior; no unsigned coarse read executes.
Quantization tests cover units, range, overflow, rounding and accumulated propagated error; publish repeated end-to-end cost/fidelity results instead of kernel-only speed claims.
limits: Fixed reduction order is necessary in some cases but does not guarantee cross-hardware bit identity.
Channel width is not an end-to-end physical error budget; propagation and correlations require analysis and experiments.
Keep benchmark versions immutable for comparison, but allow separately reviewed corrections when the benchmark itself is wrong.
The specified throughput multipliers, interactive whole world and overnight corpus remain unmeasured targets; do not make them near-term release promises.

phases.title: Integrated emergent loop
phases.entry_rule: D0 plus approved local model/interface contracts; fixtures may support isolated development

work_packages.description: Implement a read-only integration harness and versioned milestone queries over the S25 ontology with reviewed negative controls.
Execute a declared ensemble of initialization/seed conditions and report milestone occurrence, ordering, causal diversity, failures and uncertainty.
Exercise agent-triggered child runs, depth/resource guards, child-result provenance and subsequent parent decisions under S16.
Provide supported historical-state access and continuation with explicit checkpoint/certificate reconstruction semantics and measured latency.
Measure per-era compute, storage, refinement and resource budgets; record overruns and their owning model/contract.
Publish auditable run bundles and a qualified completion report with operational D17 criteria and the remaining scientific domain limits.

dependencies: Validated interfaces and relevant capability fixtures across Phases 0-15
S25 global event ontology; S23 tested compatibility matrix; S24 certificates; S16 nested provenance
Declared initial-condition mode including any D6 seeded/offline material source and any seeded replicators
A chosen operational definition of emergence, discovery and novelty; metrics must be reviewed before the evaluation ensemble is observed
acceptance: Each detector rejects appropriate missing, malformed, injected and reordered synthetic evidence; detectors cannot mutate world state.
Every run publishes its initialization provenance, supported milestone outcomes, failures and cost, rather than selecting only attractive histories.
A missing milestone is classified as implementation defect, invalid setup, resource exhaustion, numerical issue or research non-occurrence using explicit diagnostics.
Child runs are triggered by logged parent events, preserve budgets and provenance, and refuse forbidden nesting; parent influence is demonstrated without demanding an accidental wrong claim.
Measure p50/p95 state-open and continuation cost on a declared corpus; report sustained novelty only under a fixed novelty definition and time window.

Preserve the source Great Run ladder as a named demonstration benchmark: freeze its selected multi-seed cases, network-mesh/nested milestones and finite novelty window before execution; claim that benchmark complete only if its gates pass. Report the broader exploratory ensemble separately, including non-occurrence and alternate ordering.
limits: Three diverse seeds, frozen detectors and a noun filter cannot prove universal unscripted emergence. Hidden outcomes can be encoded in rules, rewards or initialization.

Do not generalize a selected demonstration ladder to every seed or an indefinite invention guarantee. Preserve informative non-occurrence in research campaigns; a failed demonstration blocks that demonstration claim, not necessarily every underlying model.
Separate product-demo completeness from scientific validation. Passing a prepared-world capability test is not evidence that the whole preceding history emerged in the same run.
All source performance targets remain conditional on measured resource budgets; source documents contain no established cluster capacity or delivery dates.

seams.upstream: Phase 6 W1 rotating-frame terms and angular-momentum accounting
seams.work: Add declared frame transforms/source terms to the continuum operator with unit and conservation checks.
seams.test: Reference rotating-frame balance and frame-change cases pass before coupled climate tests.

seams.upstream: Phase 6 W3 with Phase 5 constitutive kinetics
seams.work: Implement a parameterized viscoelastic/creep law, validity range and stress-energy coupling.
seams.test: Stress-relaxation and limiting-regime reference curves plus budget checks precede integrated scenarios.

seams.upstream: Phase 5 W2 vapor-transition kinetics
seams.work: Implement heterogeneous nucleation/growth with aerosol inputs and mass/latent-heat accounting.
downstreamGates: Phase 7 W4 cloud and rain-out controls
seams.test: Concentration/forcing ramps and aerosol-off controls match declared reference behavior and convergence.

seams.upstream: Phase 0 constants via Phase 6 W1
seams.work: Choose gravitational units/coupling, version the physical model and document calibration domain.
downstreamGates: Phase 7 W1 accretion, orbit and Hill-scale tests
seams.test: Dimensional and orbital reference cases pass on the new build; old 0.1 replay remains scoped to its original model.

seams.upstream: Phase 0/1 lattice and time-temperature model
seams.work: Choose and document an expansion model with its supported eras and versioned parameters.
seams.test: Independent age/temperature/expansion references in declared regimes; do not merely calibrate one endpoint.

seams.upstream: Phase 2 yields and Phase 7 initialization decision D6
seams.work: Implement the D6 offline Phase 2 stellar-yield source with run seed, log, build and conserved inventory. Synthetic composition fixtures are permitted for isolated component development only.
seams.test: Cache-off regeneration from the logged engine stellar run reproduces the imported inventory and provenance before integrated Phase 7 or Great Run acceptance. Synthetic fixtures leave S6 open; replacing this requirement needs an explicit scope-changing ADR.

seams.upstream: Phase 7 W7 spatial-resolution contracts, reusable foundation schema
seams.work: Define restriction/lifting, conserved state, observables, error budgets and transition validity before large spatial LOD.
seams.test: Round-trip exact retained fields and bounded observable errors across normal/shock/rare-event fixtures.

seams.upstream: Phase 6 event/interface contract plus S25 registry
seams.work: Represent external boundary driving as registered events with producer, units, affected region and conservation accounting.
seams.test: Boundary effects occur only through the logged path; replay includes the forcing and duplicate kind IDs fail.

seams.upstream: spec versioning decision D7
seams.work: Separate physics, schema/RNG and runtime compatibility versions; define migration and re-baselining policy.
seams.test: A behavior-changing constant/rate/order change cannot silently retain an incompatible baseline identity.

seams.upstream: Phase 4 W3 channel semantics
seams.work: Add bounded template/complement and catalytic reaction classes with explicit rate and conservation semantics.
seams.test: Template controls distinguish catalysis from uncatalyzed reactions and preserve molecular inventory.

seams.upstream: Phase 4 W4 and Phase 5 W2
seams.work: Implement concentration-dependent amphiphile assembly and compartment growth/breakup as kinetics, not an instantaneous label.
seams.test: Formation, persistence and breakup controls across ramps with mass/energy and resolution checks.

seams.upstream: Phase 4 W3 with Phase 6 W4 radiation input
seams.work: Register photon-driven reactions and couple supported spectral flux to chemical events without duplicating energy.
seams.test: Radiation-off/on and spectral controls verify rates and shared energy accounting.

seams.upstream: Phase 6 rigid/contact operators using Phase 5 materials
seams.work: Add articulated bodies, joint forces and conservative body-grid contact exchange.
seams.test: Reference joint/contact cases, momentum/energy transfer and work budgets pass before agent-driven scenarios.

seams.upstream: Phase 8/9 clock interface
seams.work: Retain the corrected single global timeline; add executable conformance when agents are implemented.
seams.test: Decision resolution does not introduce an independent clock; schedule jitter leaves causal time unchanged.

seams.upstream: Phase 6 W5 electromagnetic regimes
seams.work: Declare and implement the necessary time-dependent circuit, induction and propagation domains one at a time.
seams.test: Upstream capacitor/inductor/transmission/wave benchmarks precede device adoption scenarios; no hidden consumer-side physics.

seams.upstream: Spec D10 and Phase 1 event/replay mechanics
seams.work: Define child seed/run namespaces, log references, parent/child budget and result contracts, and recursion policy; prototype with tiny child fixtures.
seams.test: Stable child derivation, replay verification, malformed identity detection and logged depth refusal; world-computer equivalence remains a later explicit gate.

seams.upstream: Phase 10/9 interface, future Phase 11 implementation
seams.work: Implement sanctions as observable environment events; forbid consumer modules from directly editing policy weights.
seams.test: Architectural write-boundary tests and agent-policy traces demonstrate the corrected contract; wording alone is not closure evidence for mechanics.

seams.upstream: Phase 10 artifact/claim ledger, consumed by Phase 12 W1
seams.work: Implement stable holder/asset references, transfer causes, authorization semantics and compressed holdings in the owning ledger.
seams.test: Holdings and transfers reconcile exactly across allowed operations and compression; claim authorship is distinct from ownership.

seams.upstream: Phase 7/8 flux-event contract
seams.work: Carry sparse producer attribution through transport and aggregation without changing physical flux; distinguish known background from unknown/unattributed contributions.
seams.test: Tagged mass/energy fractions reconcile through mixing/deposition and reduction; missing tags do not silently mean natural origin.

seams.upstream: Phase 7 local tracer transport and resolution interface
seams.work: Add declared near-surface advection, diffusion and deposition with coherent exchange to coarse reservoirs and a concentration read API.
seams.test: Reference plume direction, mass balance, deposition and grid convergence; passive versus reactive scope is explicit.

seams.upstream: Phase 1 observation-map consumer; future Phase 14 provider
seams.work: Define the provider protocol early and keep Probe as a fixture; implement gaze/instrument/archive providers only when their owner models exist.
seams.test: Equal map inputs give equal consumer results in the supported same-build fixture; do not claim implemented perception from the corrected document.

seams.upstream: Foundational replay/scheduler contract, Phase 14 allocation implementation
seams.work: Separate host timing from simulated-time budget decisions; log deterministic allocation identities and inputs.
seams.test: Inject host-clock/load jitter while preserving world and allocation traces; host performance meters must not feed causal decisions.

seams.upstream: Run manifest/replay schema and runtime comparison policy
seams.work: Record numerical/runtime/build identity now for Python; later define tested hardware classes and cross-build observable comparisons.
seams.test: Mismatch handling distinguishes exact supported replay, approximate comparison and unsupported configurations; a version label alone cannot assert hardware equivalence.

seams.upstream: Certificate schema plus each owning layer: Phases 5,8,10,11,12
seams.work: Define interval bounds, retained state, assumptions, observable errors and invalidation/refinement behavior; each layer supplies its own validated implementation.
seams.test: Unsigned/incompatible summaries fail closed; adversarial interval crossings exercise refine/rollback/refuse semantics without inventing lost history.

seams.upstream: Global event/schema registry and phase interface tooling
seams.work: Register current event identities and extension rules early; generate/validate per-phase payload and producer/consumer metadata as implementations arrive.
seams.test: Collision and unknown-kind tests pass; detectors query only declared supported schemas; planned registry entries do not imply runtime implementation.

early_contracts.now: Define a run-manifest schema separating physics_build, source revision, log/schema version, RNG scheme, runtime/numerical environment, configuration and artifact hashes. Implement it first for the current Python model.
early_contracts.defer: Compiled/device compatibility, cross-platform exactness, and whole-world checkpoint support until the corresponding mechanisms and comparison corpus exist.
early_contracts.gate: Legacy 0.1 records remain interpretable; new records reject mismatched exact comparisons explicitly. Cross-build approximation is a separately named operation with specified observables.

early_contracts.now: Declare global simulation time and causal ordering independent of host clocks. Introduce an injectable test clock and deterministic scheduling/allocation event schema on a minimal fixture.
early_contracts.defer: Full perception, cognition and frame-budget mechanics until their owner phases exist.
early_contracts.gate: Changing host timing may change wall-time measurements but not current model results or fixture causal traces.

early_contracts.now: Define the certificate fields and fail-closed behavior: owner/model version, interval, preconditions, retained state, observable/error bounds, boundary events and invalidation handling. Pilot only on the existing restricted jump domain.
early_contracts.defer: Biological, institutional and monetary closures until those layers can supply and validate them.
early_contracts.gate: Unsigned or incompatible summaries cannot be scheduled. Accumulated jump hazard must be bounded over the interval/channels, not mistaken for zero because each per-step probability is small.

early_contracts.now: Create a versioned namespace/registry for existing event kinds and payload contracts, with stable causal/entity/run IDs and collision/schema checks. Reserve future extension rules rather than pretend future kinds are implemented.
early_contracts.defer: Populate each future phase's kinds when its producer/consumer contract is implemented; add milestone queries only against supported kinds.
early_contracts.gate: Duplicate identities, unknown active kinds and malformed payloads fail explicitly. Child-run namespaces cannot overlap parent event/random identities.

starter_decisions.recommended_position: Freeze 0.1 by exact source/environment/artifact digests. Reject unsupported historical execution in the new driver and direct replay to the archived source checkout; do not require permanent duplicate 0.1 kernels inside the new engine. Separate metadata-only schema changes from behavior changes.

starter_decisions.decision: Logical random addresses and generator/encoding scheme
starter_decisions.recommended_position: Use explicit stable process/species/channel identity and an attempt/draw offset, rather than a global call-order counter. Specify supported field widths, overflow rejection, collision assumptions and deterministic encoding. Distinct logical addresses and a documented generator are necessary; unequal output samples do not prove independence.

starter_decisions.decision: Reference kinetic time, propensities and controlled domain
starter_decisions.recommended_position: Start with fixed-temperature, closed, finite-population kernel controls and an independently implemented reference sampler or exact finite-state generator. Declare whether rate time is physical seconds or an explicitly named model-time unit. Keep cosmological expansion as a separate prescribed boundary until weak, nuclear and atomic rates share a justified time mapping. Define identical-reactant counting and equilibrium partition factors before tuning.

starter_decisions.decision: Atomic population state and supported temperature domain
starter_decisions.recommended_position: Represent charge-state population counts rather than one spread-filled captured-electron scalar when testing multilevel reversibility. Begin with the one-charge case as the reference control; add supported multi-charge cases with explicit transition energies/statistical factors. A capture optimization must not disable reverse ionization of existing bound populations.

Exact mode skips only intervals with proved zero omitted hazard and unchanged causal state. A separately labeled approximate mode requires a conservative integrated hazard/error budget, invalidation rules and reference comparisons. Unknown or unsupported bounds disable the jump. Choose tolerances from the declared observable requirement and reference uncertainty before inspecting candidate results.

later_decisions.why: RNG and kinetic repairs change histories; old 0.1 logs cannot silently be checked with new semantics.
later_decisions.candidate: Separate physics, RNG/event/state schema and runtime identity; preserve an archived 0.1 runner or refuse explicitly and point to its revision. Do not promise full legacy support without tests.

later_decisions.why: Removing early returns alone cannot establish detailed balance or physical time evolution.
later_decisions.candidate: Use a small explicit reference transition model, declare units and all bath/energy terms, then test a scalable sampler against it.

later_decisions.why: The source conflates a field-only engine with a nuclear acceptance run and does not specify a sufficient general joint-state representation.
later_decisions.candidate: Separate field-only numerical observables from micro-seed integration; choose the supported quantum approximation and reference cases before coding correlations.

later_decisions.why: S4/S5/S6/S9 affect later clock and inventory semantics.
later_decisions.candidate: Document units, model versions, initial-condition provenance and calibration data; do not insert a retrospective timeline factor or unnamed elemental inventory.

later_decisions.why: The source sometimes equates wanted historical outcomes with correct algorithms.
later_decisions.candidate: Separate implemented mechanism, verified numerical properties, validated physical domain and demonstrated emergence. Negative research outcomes are recorded and may require rescoping or an explicit initialized alternative.

later_decisions.decision: Adopt separately named same-environment exact replay, complete checkpoint restoration, exact compatible-runtime replay, and bounded cross-build comparison. Every test and report names one class.
List exact retained fields and approximate observables for every representation. Select eager invalidation or recoverable rollback before a scheduler can cross a certified interval.

Declare whether a scenario continues a prior generated history, imports recorded offline output, or uses a synthetic fixture. Seeded matter/replicators are not silently promoted to end-to-end emergence.

Hard-fail structural/accounting/replay violations. Report hypothesis failures and non-occurrence separately; they block the corresponding scientific claim rather than automatically proving a coding defect.

Pre-register predicates, negative controls, ensemble design, uncertainty and failure taxonomy. Numeric benchmark thresholds require justification; original week-by-week estimates and blank performance targets are not commitments.
Exact replay verifies a saved realization. Independent replication compares a stated effect under controlled independent experiments and uncertainty; claims must not conflate them.
Capability fixtures may initialize bounded systems openly. World-generating runs must record all such initialization and interventions. String bans are secondary lints, not proofs of emergence.

milestone_exit: A preserved 0.1 baseline remains reproducible in its supported environment.
The candidate has explicit manifest/event/RNG/state/time/accounting contracts and passes their deterministic tests.
Bounded nuclear and atomic controls demonstrate the specified reversible finite-system kinetics from both sides, under a registered reference protocol.
Jump behavior is either conservatively disabled or justified under an explicit exact/approximate certificate.
An honest validation dossier defines accepted behavior and unresolved science before any expansion to more world layers.
Phase 0/1 research ambitions not exercised by these controls remain open; no interference, entanglement, full cosmology, chemistry, biological or societal capability is implied.

verification_policy.fixture_policy: Fixture-backed local development is allowed when initialization/provenance is explicit. Integration gates require the implemented producer contracts.
verification_policy.numeric_policy: Commit units, domain, calibration/held-out split, reference method, uncertainty, sample/power and tolerances before observing candidate evaluation results.
verification_policy.completion_policy: Verified records require concrete evidence. A full-phase label requires its local and applicable integration gates; one is not a substitute for the other.
